SPI3DER · MADE IN ONE CLAUDE CHAT

The spider
teaches sculpting.

This film came out of a single conversation with Claude through the spi3der plugin. The official logo became a 3D model, got a rig, a terrain and a walk, then learnt to shape a box with alternating extrude (E) and scale (S) — every operation shown as a process, not a jump cut. Below, the conversation replays message by message, and the film plays where it played first: inside the chat.
